framing.placement_vs_timing: Test year: no dynamic carbon search (K, W, L) improves on the static clean-region ranking S (H3 not supported); K emits more than S (9.9 t more; K − S = +9.9 t, b = 4 95% interval [+0.8 t, +19.5 t]; the interval excludes zero); W and L are not distinguishable from S (W − S = +3.9 t [-4.7 t, +13.8 t]; L − S = +6.6 t [-2.0 t, +16.7 t]). Waiting in Utah alone saves about 0.8% (W_time 0.77%, L_time 0.79% vs U); the saving comes from moving work (L 22.11% vs U), mostly to BPAT (67% of L's remote execution energy).
framing.greedy_search: Per-job greedy search, including hindsight H, is not a cohort optimum; holding scarce BPAT slots for cleaner hours pushes later jobs to dirtier sites.
framing.h_is_diagnostic: H uses realized (filled) truth; it is never a contender
